title: Retractable Hooks and Garment Rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass, Traditional Style Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with a wall mount retractable hook/garment rod that pulls out for 2-1/2 inches of usable hanging space, then pushes back in when not needed.

Highlights
- Retractable rod (retractable hook / garment rod) provides 2-1/2" hanging space for coats, robes, towels
- Wall mount accessory helps keep items within reach and saves floor space
- Solid brass construction
- Holds up to 15 lb when installed as directed
- Tip can be customized: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own

Specs & Installation
- Dimensions: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L; projection 1"
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount; fits standard interior walls
- Hardware included: 6/32 toggles and all mounting hardware
- Drilling required: 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Assembly required: No

Design & Keywords
A refined choice for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Offered in multiple designer finish options including statement colors.

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
